title: Synthetic IMDb analytics
description: Read-only analytical joins over a deterministic synthetic movie dataset.

benchmark.init_command: ARG_PSQL_PATH -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h ARG_PG_HOST -p ARG_PG_PORT -U ARG_PG_USER -d ARG_PG_DATABASE -f ARG_WORKLOAD_PATH/sql/schema.sql && PG_PERF_BENCH_PSQL='ARG_PSQL_PATH' python3 ARG_WORKLOAD_PATH/generator.py --scale ARG_WORKLOAD_SCALE && ARG_PSQL_PATH -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h ARG_PG_HOST -p ARG_PG_PORT -U ARG_PG_USER -d ARG_PG_DATABASE -f ARG_WORKLOAD_PATH/sql/indexes.sql
benchmark.workload_command: ARG_PGBENCH_PATH --no-vacuum --client=ARG_PGBENCH_CLIENTS --jobs=ARG_PGBENCH_CLIENTS --time=ARG_WORKLOAD_DURATION_SECONDS --progress=10 -h ARG_PG_HOST -p ARG_PG_PORT -U ARG_PG_USER -f ARG_WORKLOAD_PATH/sql/01_company_catalog.sql -f ARG_WORKLOAD_PATH/sql/02_people_by_keyword.sql -f ARG_WORKLOAD_PATH/sql/03_keyword_trends.sql -f ARG_WORKLOAD_PATH/sql/04_genre_cast.sql -f ARG_WORKLOAD_PATH/sql/05_join_stress.sql ARG_PG_DATABASE
